scope.payloads: A reached distinct same-kind node requires an allocated finite DIRECT trace graph with primitive, valid string-carrier or acyclic array payloads. Shared identity and different exact child classes skip captured payload validation; object or cyclic trace payloads can therefore remain unvisited. Their canonical images and finite previous paths are still authenticated. Materialized/freeing nodes, longer or cyclic previous paths, subclasses, FiberError, deeper root guards and pending states remain partial.
